summary: ProText Mobility, Inc. filed a voluntary Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to publicly disseminate a press release dated June 12, 2026, announcing the launch of a new corporate website and investor relations platform, along with a shareholder update concerning its biotechnology, pharmaceutical infrastructure, digital systems, international strategic relationship, and exchange-uplisting initiatives. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, liquidating event, management departure, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine transparency and public relations update by a former SEC reporting company voluntarily submitting to EDGAR. There are no deal terms, recommended actions, structural mechanics, or arbitrage angles to analyze.
